title: Club Fair Information
transcript: Hi everyone, welcome back. Next Wednesday, the student union is hosting the fall club fair from eleven to two in the main hall. More than eighty clubs will have tables, from chess and hiking to robotics. If you're already in a club and want a table, the deadline to register is this Friday, and spaces are filling up fast. Even if you just want to look around, it's a great way to meet people.

questions.stem: What is the announcement mainly about?
options: A new club that is looking for members
A change in the student union's hours
An upcoming event where clubs share information
questions.explanation: The speaker describes the fall club fair where clubs will have tables.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker say spaces are filling up fast?
options: To apologize for a lack of tables
To explain why the fair was moved
To suggest that students arrive early
To urge club members to register soon
questions.explanation: The speaker mentions the Friday deadline and that spaces are filling up to encourage quick registration.
